summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in orderbook-volt-plugin@0.0.2
details: Package orderbook-volt-plugin@0.0.2 was examined and no indicators of installer-side harm were identified. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no credential or environment scraping, no silent relay of caller data to third-party endpoints, no backdoor or persistence mechanisms, and no shipped third-party credentials were observed in the package's files.
